profile.reading: Petadata occupies a single suite, number 116, at 39159 Paseo Padre Parkway in Fremont, within Alameda County's stretch of the San Francisco Bay Area technology corridor. The OpenStreetMap record tags the site as a data center, and the name itself, a play on petabyte, points toward a company built around large scale data storage or hosting. A suite number at a multi tenant business address is a common way small IT, colocation, or managed hosting firms lease space rather than own a purpose built building, so a modest storage or backup operation at this location is plausible. It would not be a hyperscale campus. No operating company website could be confirmed at this address. The dot com domain sharing the Petadata name is a resale listing unconnected to any data business, and no working site could be reached at the more likely petadata dot io address. Without a confirmed operator site, business registration, or press coverage tied to this suite, its exact function, whether that is a small hosting company, IT services office, or another kind of tenant entirely, cannot be established from public information. This entry is published as an honest placeholder rather than a guess, and will be updated if a confirmed operator surfaces.
